The Dockerfile corroborates this: `REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER`/`REGIONALSTATISTIK_SECRET` are required secrets for the full build (even the official Docker build needs these via build secrets). These are credentials for a private statistics service, not something available in this environment.

The app statically imports `einwohner.csv` in `AutoCardHeader.tsx`. Without it, the dev server will fail to compile pages that use this component (the mobility page). However, the Next.js dev server might still start and be able to serve other pages — compilation errors in Next dev only occur when you request that page.

2. `yarn install` — done, exit code 0
3. `yarn dev` — should be accessible at http://localhost:3000
